tools.name: compose_figure
tools.description: Compose a multi-panel scientific figure layout. Takes panel pixel dimensions (and optional detected axis positions per panel) plus figure settings, returns panel positions/sizes in millimetres using the aligned-grid engine: axis lines aligned per column/row, plot areas matched so baked-in text sizes

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get current pricing for Data Figure Studio and whether payments are configured.

tools.name: create_paypal_checkout
tools.description: Create a PayPal Checkout order for high-res figure credits. Returns an approve URL for the human and the order id. After approval, call capture_paypal_purchase.

tools.name: capture_paypal_purchase
tools.description: Capture (complete) an approved PayPal order and receive the signed credit token.

tools.name: create_usdc_order
tools.description: Create a USDC payment order on Solana or Ethereum, paid to the store wallet (fees ~$0 on Solana; buyer pays ETH gas on Ethereum). Returns payment instructions incl. a Solana Pay URL and reference.

tools.name: build_usdc_solana_tx
tools.description: Build the unsigned Solana USDC payment transaction for an order; the buyer signs and submits it with their wallet.

tools.name: verify_usdc_order
tools.description: Check an order USDC payment on-chain (Solana: by signature or reference scan; Ethereum: by tx_hash after confirmations) and receive the signed credit token when paid.

tools.name: get_sales_report
tools.description: OWNER ONLY: read the purchase ledger (totals + recent records, split by human vs agent buyers). Requires the admin_key (the ADMIN_KEY env var of the deployment).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_sales_report" references sensitive artifacts (env var). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
